name: print-social-cosmetology-clinic-cover-with-leaf-and-line-frame
title: Beauty clinic cover: face half hidden behind a leaf inside a thin white rounded frame with flared serif type
whatItIs: A dark green photo of a woman with one side of her face hidden behind a large tropical leaf, her nails visible. A thin white rounded rectangle frames the image, with a flared serif 'ABC MED' at top left, a small city label at top right and huge 'КОСМЕТОЛОГИЯ' along the bottom edge.
whatItMeans: Elegant and natural; the leaf half-mask is a classic beauty gesture and the frame gives a magazine feel.
techniques: Half-hide the face with a natural prop.
Draw a thin white keyline frame inside the photo.
Set big flared serif type along the frame.
Keep the palette to green and skin tones.

vocabulary.definition: A thin outline drawn inside an image.
A serif with slightly widening stroke ends.
An object covering part of a face.
Text running along the frame edge.
